items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Papa Jo, I got to meet – we got to be good friends.

ctx.x: How about Papa Jones, speaking about . . . ?

Papa Jo, I got to meet – we got to be good friends. In fact, at one time he used to come see me and bring me an apple. I don’t know what that about. He was a bizarre man, but he was good drummer. I loved it. Everybody loved it, because he had a way of teaching. The way he learned is from Kansas City. He learned from playing with tap dancers. So a lot of his stuff, when you see him doing things, a lot of his stuff is about tap dancing. He’s got a lot of things he did because of that. He wrote – there’s some tapes…
